text:
The bowl looks like it holds cubed tofu, a dollop of tahini or peanut/nut butter, red onion, carrot, and possibly some bell pepper.

I estimated the tofu at about 250 g. At roughly 120 kcal per 100 g for firm tofu, that is about 300 kcal.

The sauce is about 30 g. If it is tahini at roughly 600 kcal per 100 g, that is about 180 kcal.

The vegetables (onion, carrot, pepper) come to about 80 g, or about 30 kcal.

Total mass is about 360 g and total energy is about 510 kcal.
